title: A beam ejected with a temperature linear through its depth, cooled to a uniform temperature
source: Timoshenko and Goodier, Theory of Elasticity, 3rd ed., McGraw-Hill 1970, §150 (a thermal strain linear in the coordinates is compatible and leaves a free body stress-free): the thermal strain α (T − T₀(z)) is linear in z, so the free beam bends stress-free to the curvature α dT₀/dz and its mid-line shrinks by α (T − T₀)
